description: Canonical (sorted-key JSON) SHA-256 digests of the Pocket Pet content profile the transitional installer (source/content-installers/template-games.cts) produced at 3601c0c (catalog and pet presentation definitions), before the data moved to docs/concepts/pocket-pet, with the game's own storage namespace added. The game-folders suite compares the folder profile against it. The pet.assets section and the whole-profile digest were recaptured once, after the generated definitions in docs/concepts/pocket-pet/assets were re-synchronized from their Scene Forge recipes with `littlewild sync`: 110 baked meshes gained the authored UVs the exporter writes (positions, normals, indices, materials, rig, metadata and the other sections are unchanged).
